title: Utility Items
html:
Utility items are items which help you progress through the game. They are split in four catagories: Waypoint Scrolls, Health Potions, Mana Potions and Kings Coins. Utility Items except Kings Coins can be bought at the merchant Audrey the Alchemist in Townston or the merchant Samford the Hermit.

Contents

  • 1 Waypoint Scrolls
  • 2 Health Potions
  • 3 Mana Potions
  • 4 Kings Coins

Waypoint Scrolls

These are scrolls which create a waypoint at the location your character is at. The waypoint then allows you to telport back to Townston. It also acts as a save point while you are logged in as you can use any obelisk to return to your open waypoint. You can only have one waypoint open at a time, if you use a waypoint scroll while you have an existing waypoint the old waypoint is removed and a new one created where you are.you can hold 5 in each each space.

Health Potions

Health potions restore a large portion of your health over a certain length of time. There are two types of health potions.

  • Minor Health Potions, they Replenishes 40% health over 5 seconds.
  • Major Health Potions, they Heals 50% health over 5 seconds, are stackable and require a Membership.

Mana Potions

Mana potions restore a large portion of your mana over a certain length of time. There are two types of mana potions. They are minor mana potions and major mana potions.

  • Minor mana potions can be used by both nonmembers and members, they regenerate 40% health over 5 seconds.
  • Major mana potions can only be used by members, they regenerate 50% of your mana over 5 secs and the restoration effects stack. You can also store up to 10 potions per inventory space.

Kings Coins

King's Coins are special items, they are Soulbound and have the same color as quest items. They are obtainable as loot from monsters and chests. They are also offered as rewards for some quests and people will often farm repeatable quests to collect kings coins. They are exchangeable at the Token Masters or at Sam's Dungeon Wholesale. Token masters give yellow items for them and Sam will give purple items or very rarely rainbow items. For more information about Sam visit the Sam's Dungeon Wholesale page.
